name: Yiming Lin
role: Postdoctoral Researcher, University of California, Berkeley
bio_paragraphs: Yiming is currently a Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of California, Berkeley, working with Prof. Aditya Parameswaran. He earned his Ph.D. from the University of California, Irvine, under the supervision of Prof. Sharad Mehrotra, and his bachelor’s degree from the Harbin Institute of Technology. He is broadly interested in building data management systems at the intersection of structured and unstructured data with Large Language Models (LLMs). His recent research explores developing LLM-powered data systems for multimodal analytics, with a focus on extracting structure from unstructured documents, supporting scalable AI computations, provenance in LLM-powered data processing, and agentic query engines.
photography_paragraph: He loves landscape photography and traveling, and keeps sharing the most recent photographs on his 500px.
